mapper.select: SELECT distinct o.id FROM system_org_user ou LEFT JOIN system_org o on ou.org_id = o.id and o.deleted = b'0' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ou.deleted = b'0'

select u.id, bu.nickname as nickname, u.nickname as username, ou.id orgUserId, ou.type, ou.visible from system_users u inner join system_org_user ou on u.id = ou.user_id and ou.deleted = b'0' and ou.org_id = #{pageReqVO.orgId} LEFT JOIN system_business_user bu ON bu.user_id = u.id and bu.deleted = b'0' and bu.business_id = ou.business_id where u.deleted = b'0'
and (u.nickname like concat('%', #{pageReqVO.nickname}, '%') or u.username like concat('%', #{pageReqVO.nickname}, '%'))
order by ou.type desc, u.create_time asc

select u.id as userId, bu.nickname as nickname from system_users u inner join system_org_user ou on u.id = ou.user_id and ou.deleted = b'0' and ou.org_id = #{orgId} LEFT JOIN system_business_user bu ON bu.user_id = u.id and bu.deleted = b'0' and bu.business_id = ou.business_id where u.deleted = b'0' order by ou.type desc, u.create_time asc

select ifnull(count(su.id),0) as userNum, org_id as orgId from system_users su left join system_org_user sou on sou.user_id = su.id and sou.deleted = b'0' where su.deleted = b'0'
and sou.org_id in
#{unionId}
group by org_id
